breakpoints.note: After the fuzzer strips its 6-byte prefix, `findFileFormatBuffer(data, &format)` sees the remaining slice's `BM` magic and sets `format = IFF_BMP`. The same infoheader also carries `biCompression = 0`, so the uncompressed-BMP rejection inside `pixReadMemBmp` is not taken.
First project-side materialization of an attacker-controlled signed size field used by the vulnerable colormap math.

breakpoints.code:
cmapbytes = offset - BMP_FHBYTES - ihbytes;
cmapEntries = cmapbytes / sizeof(RGBA_QUAD);
breakpoints.note: For the staged witness this arithmetic yields `cmapbytes = 197` and `cmapEntries = 49`, so the parser arms the colormap copy instead of rejecting the malformed header. The staged patch fixes this witness-specific obligation by rejecting `ihbytes` outside `{40, 108, 124}` before these calculations.
